description: This PHP class defines a sample invoice group template for PDF generation in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to generate the body, header, and footer of the invoice PDF using dynamic data placeholders and translation functions.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides a sample template for generating invoice PDFs with dynamic content and layout.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the body of the invoice PDF, incorporating dynamic data placeholders and translations.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header content for the PDF; currently empty.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer HTML content for the PDF, including page number and date placeholders.
